articles.translatedExcerpt: RAM FIGHTER, a rapper based in Kobe, released his 5th album ``Until I Rotten'' on November 25, 2026. RAM FIGHTER is a rapper who has created stories that intertwine love and loss, happiness and despair based on personal memories and fantasies. This album, which is his fifth album in total, is an album that depicts everything from past wounds and loneliness to the current daily life spent with loved ones. While writing about his own experiences in the style of a personal novel, he expresses the happiness he has found through his interactions with people. Contains a total of 19 songs, including the lead singles "doublet", "Yui Hirasawa", "Ham Sanpo", and "Ou". Guest performances include iga, kiriej, safmusic, and Pu$h!. articles.translatedExcerpt: Porno Graffitti has announced that they will release the music video for "Zankyo" from their 13th album "Kajitsu" released on September 9, 2026 at 8pm on November 28th. This song is the only love song included on the album, and is based on the theme of the sounds of memories that never fade, depicting ``attachment to something lost'' and ``the will to move forward despite this,'' and it is said to be a work that strongly expresses the lyricism unique to the lyrics and composer Seiichi Shindo. The music video stars Masaru Kasamatsu and Yu Imou, and depicts the irreplaceable time of lovers and the loss that results from their sudden breakup. The story focuses on words that could not be conveyed even though they wanted to, feelings that were left behind, and the ``echoes of memories'' that remain after losing a loved one, and depicts how they face their loss. It's not the lost existence itself, but the emotions and memories left behind by that person that still continue to resonate deep within my heart...

articles.translatedTitle: Karen Tsuchiya's new song "BAD BIRTHDAY" will be released "I created a birthday song that is difficult to sing on your birthday"
articles.translatedExcerpt: Tsuchiya Karen has announced that she will digitally release her digital single "BAD BIRTHDAY" on December 2, 2026. This work is said to be based on an incident that actually happened on his own birthday, and depicts the complicated feelings of not being able to be happy even though it's his birthday. Using realistic and humorous words, he expresses the feelings of feeling depressed when looking back on the past, feeling unmotivated to do anything, and not being able to accept even the congratulations from those around you. It is said that it is a song that depicts not only expectations and joy, but also impatience, loneliness, some perverse feelings, and a bitter smile at oneself, set to a bright melody, and that can relate to the feelings of not being able to be honest. Karen Tsuchiya also commented on "BAD BIRTHDAY" as follows: ◆ ◆ ◆ ◾️Karen Tsuchiya Comment It's my favorite snack for my birthday...

articles.translatedExcerpt: SIRUP has started distributing the short version of their new song "One feat. eill (Prod. uin)" featuring singer-songwriter eill as a guest on TikTok and Instagram from their digital EP "Whereabouts?" to be released on December 2, 2026. This song expresses the feeling that in a capitalist and competitive society, rather than comparing ourselves to others or winning something, we should give each other love as we are, simply enjoy the time we spend together, and never let the casual daily life and space we spend with our loved ones be taken away from us. Produced by uin, who is active across genres from hip-hop to R&B to pop, this is a bright and positive vibe with an R&B-based sound that shines with light beats and bouncy grooves.

articles.translatedTitle: JO1 member Yonashiro Sho is appointed as the tourism ambassador for Naha City, Okinawa Prefecture. Solo song “Domestic” digital release also available
articles.translatedExcerpt: JO1 member Sho Yonashiro has announced that he has been appointed as a ``Naha City Tourism Ambassador'' to promote the charms of his hometown, Naha City, Okinawa Prefecture. Furthermore, Yonashiro's solo original song ``Idemo'' was also released today. Yonashiro appeared at events as an ambassador for the ``Warrior Castle Restoration Caravan,'' and also appeared in a drama set in Okinawa. He has spoken of his love for his hometown in interviews and radio programs, and it is in response to these activities that he was appointed to this position. Yonashiro, who received the letter of commission from Naha Mayor Chinenge, expressed his enthusiasm, saying, ``As JO1, Yonashiro Sho, and as a tourism ambassador, I will do my best even if I have a limited ability! Thank you very much!!'' In addition, the newly released song ``Idomodemo'' was written and composed by Yonashiro himself, and it is a straightforward song that affirms hesitation and detours, and expresses the strength to move forward even in the face of weakness.

articles.translatedExcerpt: Sato Tokyo Go released a new single "Kakata" on November 25, 2026 (Wednesday). In this work, while the rhythm section includes support members for the first time, Sato himself is in charge of all track production, including keyboards, saxophone, and other programming, as usual. The songs, which have beautiful soundscapes rooted in existential theory, develop in conjunction with words that only he can possess. If we consider the main track, which is centered around a keyboard melody, with irregular rhythms and varying speeds, as the "back", it has a composition that reveals an ambient, otherworldly world reminiscent of James Blake or Bon Iver. articles.translatedExcerpt: Ryo Umekawa released his digital EP “WORKING CRASS HERO” today. Ryo Umekawa has openly and delicately translated into his songs the anguish, conflict, and antithesis of the status quo that he faced while spending his days as a "real office worker." This work is said to embody his artist concept. In addition to the five songs released so far, the album includes a total of seven songs, including "Weekend March (Weekday Version) feat. asmi" with guest vocalist asmi, and the new song "Today is something too." The jacket artwork was created by Shoichi Haga, known for the manga ``How do you live?'' In addition, the new song "Today is also something" is for people who live every day to protect what is important to them even in an unreasonable society...

articles.translatedTitle: Green Yellow Society will release the MV for “Utamago” filmed at Chukyo University Chukyo, the place where they were formed.
articles.translatedExcerpt: Green Yellow Society has announced that the music video for their latest song "Utamago" will be premiered at 12:00 on November 28, 2026. This song is included in their 6th album "Atamago" released on September 9th, and was written and composed by Haruko Nagaya (Vo). The song was created with the concept of looking back on how they felt when they first started the band, and wanting to create a song that would be like a school song for the green-yellow society. The MV was filmed at Chukyo University Chukyo High School, the alma mater of Haruko Nagaya, Issei Kobayashi (G), and Peppe (Key), and where the band was formed. In addition to footage of the members performing in the band research club room and gymnasium, which are full of memories, the casual daily lives of current students are shown, such as the nostalgic scenery of the school building, how they devote themselves to club activities, and how they enjoy time with friends, resulting in a video full of the sparkle of youth and nostalgia.

articles.translatedExcerpt: The movie “Are you in love?” depicting the trajectory of Kiyoshiro Imawano. ``Kiyoshiro Imawano Taught Me'' has been a long hit. Kiyoshiro Imawano continued to sing since forming RC Succession on November 23, 1968 while still in high school until his death on May 2, 2009. This is a documentary commemorating the 55th anniversary of Kiyoshiro's debut, tracing the path of Kiyoshiro Imawano, who brought about change in the Japanese music scene with love and rebellion in his heart, and approaches the essence of his unparalleled expression. Recording scenery, a keen eye on society, and numerous events that caused a stir in the world. This work deeply delves into his ``attitude to stick to his beliefs'' and ``unique performance'' from multiple angles. Since the screening began in October, the film has not only been shown at movie theaters across the country, but also held special screenings, talk shows, listening events at CD shops, and special features on terrestrial television programs, making it a big hit across generations.

articles.translatedTitle: [Live Report] Stray Kids' love and promise resonated at Tokyo Dome "We'll be back with 8 of us!"
articles.translatedExcerpt: "Stray Kids World Tour" started at the National Stadium in August. After stops in Nagoya, Osaka, and Fukuoka, an additional performance was held at Tokyo Dome for three days from November 6th to 8th. At the final on the 8th, the eight participants reflected on their progress so far, and at the same time depicted the determination of the eight participants to continue running toward the future. We will report on the night that was the culmination of the Japan performance. What I felt while watching the stage on the third day at Tokyo Dome were two keywords: ``return to roots'' and ``accelerate toward the future.'' While following the trajectory that has been accumulated since their debut, the composition connects all of them to the future. What was most impressive was that the members themselves were enjoying the stage more than anyone else. A free, natural, yet perfect performance. A new goal that only Stray Kids has been able to achieve...

articles.translatedTitle: mol-74 Kazuki Takeichi's solo project Alt Quark releases first MV "Tsuki no Oi"
articles.translatedExcerpt: Alt Quark, the solo project of mol-74 vocalist Kazuki Takeichi, has released the music video for "Tsuki no Oi", which was digitally released on November 18, 2026. This is Alt Quark's first music video. The MV is set in a coin laundry at night. The film is a quiet, cinematic film that carefully captures everyday fragments of everyday life, centering on a story about the memory of smells. The tranquil and unpretentious world view of the song, which is played on the piano, and the natural atmosphere of the video harmonize beautifully. The director was Yutaka Tsunemaji, who is active in a wide range of fields including movies, dramas, and music videos. His directorial work ``Kono Hibi ga Calm'' was officially invited to the 45th Moscow International Film Festival, and he has also worked on music videos for many artists such as Hitsuji Bungaku, Uru, and Ikimonogakari.

articles.title: FLANKRE、4か月ぶりの新曲「HOPE」リリース
articles.excerpt: FLANKREが2026年11月20日(金)にニューシングル「HOPE」をリリースした。 約4ヶ月ぶりとなる本作は、バンドセットとソロセットで2種類のアレンジが存在し、過去にライブで度々演奏されていた。レコーディングでは2つのアレンジを組み合わせたハイブリットなアレンジとなった。 リズムマシンと生のドラムが共存することで、無機質さと暖かさを両立したサウンドとなった本楽曲。楽曲の持つ「絶望の中に見える一筋の希望」といった世界観を引き立たせており、癖になるギターリフやベースソロも見どころとなっている。 リリース情報 https://ototoy.jp/_/default/a/1355594 アーティスト情報 https://www.instagram.com/_flnkr_/ https://x.com/_f…
articles.translatedTitle: FLANKRE releases new song “HOPE” for the first time in 4 months
articles.translatedExcerpt: FLANKRE released their new single “HOPE” on Friday, November 20, 2026. This work, which was released for the first time in about 4 months, has two arrangements: a band set and a solo set, and has been performed frequently at live performances in the past. The recording was a hybrid arrangement that combined the two arrangements. The coexistence of a rhythm machine and live drums creates a sound that is both inorganic and warm. The song's worldview of ``a ray of hope amidst despair'' is highlighted, and the addictive guitar riff and bass solo are also highlights. The song was produced by SKYTOPIA, and the track incorporates various musical elements such as garage, jersey club, and electro swing, with a dreamy chord progression, and a gap between dreams and reality...

articles.translatedTitle: TOMORROW X TOGETHER, “Angel Bite” performance film released
articles.translatedExcerpt: TOMORROW The previously released music videos depicted the stories of five youths in different situations, but this performance film focuses on expressing emotions through dance. The video takes place in everyday spaces such as small rooms, alleyways, and karaoke. The choreography of him lying on the floor overlaps with the figure of him lying listlessly in the room, and the choreography also blends into the scene where he faces his reflection in the mirror and expresses his anger. The production puts more emphasis on conveying the emotions and story of the characters than on elaborate group dances, resulting in an impressive video. The message of "Angel Bite" is about not wanting to let go of someone important to you, even as you self-mockingly look at the pain and sense of loss...

articles.translatedTitle: Yuka Nagase releases advance SG “Next wa Weather Forecast” from new AL
articles.translatedExcerpt: It has been decided that Yuka Nagase will release her new single "Oji wa Weather Forecast" on Friday, November 20, 2026. This song is the lead single from her first full-length album in about a year and a half, “Hobutsu Inori.” The album is a collection of works that explore the new environment and changes in psychology that Yuka Nagase herself feels, and the theme is "prayer" for oneself and others. This work was recorded at home, with Yuka Nagase writing all the lyrics and songs for the full album, in a style that is closer to being independent. It is a work that reinterprets the new wave indie pop of the 1980s. In addition, the visualizer music video for the lead single "Otsugi wa Weather Forecast" has been released. The music video for ``Name your disease,'' which everyone agrees with, ``I can't deal with troublesome things'' and ``I can't think about other people's feelings,'' is a work that mixes the serious and the comedic, with Sho Kiryuin suffering from the desperation of wanting to know the true nature of his own difficulties in life, and Yutaka Kiya, Jun Utahiroro, and Kenji Tarumishu dancing cheerfully. The jacket photo is set in a gothic worldview, with a dynamic, suspicious, and fearless smile of Kiyabu, Uta Hiroba, and Tarumi Sake, expressing something in a pop-like composition that seems to be holding down Kiryuin. articles.translatedExcerpt: Kei Owada will release his new single "Iris" on Friday, November 20, 2026. This work is a song that further deepens the neo-soul that Kei Owada has made one of the core of his musical style since his debut EP in 2012. The producer was Jun Miyagawa, a multi-keyboardist who has participated in works and live performances by Kenshi Yonezu, Kaze Fujii, KIRINJI, and is also active as LAGHEADS. He has also worked with Miyagawa on the EP "LIFE" released in 2021 and the EP "Sweet Premonition" released in 2023. Also, Shunsuke Ochi, who is also a member of CRCK/LCKS, is participating on bass. articles.translatedTitle: A.Valley releases pleasant collaboration song “Kinjo”
articles.translatedExcerpt: A.Valley released a collaboration single “Kinjo” with Mekkelowoneee on Wednesday, November 18, 2026. This work is a song that will accompany you in relaxing time with long-time friends or casual time driving around your hometown. Behind the song is the bond between two people that has been nurtured beyond culture and distance. A.Valley, who has traveled back and forth between the United States and Japan, reflected on his roots and wrote about his love for all the cities and communities he encountered during his travels. Mekkelowoneee, who wrote the track, supports the lyrics with a natural and pleasant beat, giving the entire song a 100% pure feel-good mood. articles.translatedTitle: Redhair Rosy to release major debut album “MCFDN”
articles.translatedExcerpt: Redhair Rosy has announced that her major debut album "MCFDN" will be released on March 10, 2027. The album title ``MCFDN'' comes from their previous band, ``the McFaddin.'' the McFaddin was formed mainly by members who met in Osaka. The band, which was the epitome of youth for the members, made music together, spent time together, and ended its activities in April 2024. After that, the same members started a new journey as "Redhair Rosy". The title song "Iraza" is a short tune that, as the title suggests, uses the emotion of "irritation" as its engine. ``The power of irritation'' and ``stress is power'' and the thrill of not just canceling out frustration and stress, but turning it into the strength to move forward is unique to Rapid Tokyo. The phrases ``Sore-ish'' and ``That-like'' are played on like a play on words, and seem to be an ironic take on the current world, which is full of borrowed words and ``uniqueness.''
